# Beegen
> The sales operating system for Mexican small businesses. A free CRM is the hub; every service is a module bought separately; a WhatsApp AI agent that acts (books, quotes, charges, invoices, reminds, asks for reviews) rather than just replying.

Tagline: "Meta te contesta. Beegen te vende." (Meta answers you. Beegen sells for you.)

Beegen is built for micro and small businesses in Mexico that sell on WhatsApp. Every lead from a web form, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or a call lands in one CRM with a per-contact timeline. One AI agent (powered by Claude) works those leads across channels and can take actions through the modules the business has enabled. Copy is Spanish first, with an English toggle. Prices are in MXN with IVA (VAT) included.

## Modules and pricing (MXN per month, IVA included)
- CRM (`crm`): free forever, 1 seat included, unlimited contacts (fair use), pipeline, tasks, import. $99 per extra seat. Available now. https://beegen.co/crm
- Sitio web / Website (`site`): $149 per published site. AI-built site with pages, contact form and WhatsApp button; 100 AI edits per site per month (fair use), custom domain. Every form submission creates a contact in the CRM. Available now. https://beegen.co/sitio-web
- Agente de WhatsApp / WhatsApp agent (`wa_agent`): $299 per number, 200 AI conversations per month included (a conversation is one contact per 24-hour window, on any channel), $2 per extra conversation. Answers, qualifies, books, quotes, charges and hands off to a human with context. Calls to the WhatsApp number are answered by the agent in chat, at no extra cost. Available now. https://beegen.co/whatsapp
- Recordatorios y seguimientos / Reminders (`reminders`): $99, 200 utility messages included, marketing messages $1 each, extra utility messages at Meta cost + 20%. Appointment reminders, payment nudges, follow-ups via Meta-approved templates, plus 7 included automations (stuck deal, no-show, payment reminder, low review, inactive contact, welcome new lead, appointment 24 h and 2 h before). Coming soon. https://beegen.co/recordatorios
- Cobros / Payments (`payments`): $0 monthly + 2% per payment collected, plus Stripe's fee. Payment links from the chat or a deal; card, OXXO, SPEI, interest-free installments via Stripe. Coming soon. https://beegen.co/cobros
- Facturación CFDI / Invoicing (`invoicing`): $149, 30 folios included, $3 per extra folio. The agent collects RFC, postal code, tax regime and CFDI use and stamps the invoice through a SAT-authorized PAC. Coming soon. https://beegen.co/facturacion
- Reseñas Google / Google reviews (`reviews`): $99. Asks for a Google review after a booking or payment with the direct link. Coming soon. https://beegen.co/resenas
- Instagram y Messenger (`social_channels`): $99 per connected account; requires the WhatsApp agent and its conversations count against the agent's 200. Coming soon. https://beegen.co/instagram-messenger
- Cotizaciones / Quotes (`quotes`): $99. PDF quotes from a chat or deal, public accept/decline page, accept and pay through Cobros, invoice through Facturación CFDI. Coming soon. https://beegen.co/cotizaciones
- Voz / Voice: no longer a separate module. Calls to the WhatsApp number are answered by the agent in chat as part of the WhatsApp agent.

## For agencies
- Espacio para agencias / Agency workspace (`agency`): $1,499 per month per agency. Create and run every client's Beegen from one account, client switching in a click, light white-label (agency logo and name), unlimited clients. Clients keep their own subscriptions at list price; the resale price is the agency's. Coming soon. https://beegen.co/agencias

## Bundles
- Beegen Ventas: $499 per month. WhatsApp agent (1 number), reminders, payments, Google reviews, CRM with 3 seats.
- Beegen Negocio: $899 per month. Every module (including Instagram y Messenger and Cotizaciones), 2 WhatsApp numbers, CRM with 5 seats.
- Annual prepay: 12 months for the price of 10, payable at OXXO or by SPEI in one payment.
- Done-for-you onboarding, one-time: Arranque $999 (number connected, business information loaded, agent answering in the business's tone within 48 hours) and Completo $1,999 (everything in Arranque plus website published, reminder templates approved by Meta, Payments and Invoicing set up). Requested via WhatsApp from the pricing page.

## Trials and billing
- Every module has an independent 14-day free trial, no card required.
- Seats are only charged for the CRM and shared inbox ($99 per extra seat); the website and the agent do not charge per user.
- Usage overages are billed at the end of the month and shown in real time in the dashboard.
- Beegen issues a CFDI invoice for every payment.
- Existing Starter/Pro website plans map to the Website module; existing WhatsApp slots map to the WhatsApp agent.
